title: Supplier Messages and Value Put Back on a Car Rental
content:
Value may be put back for the messages a supplier has sent about a hire booked under the
Car Rental Rate Classes, and whether it is put back turns on the renter's own cover under the
Travel Protection Plans. Value is put back on these terms because a travel protection policy answers only
what the supplier has not returned, so what the desk can release it releases.

The cover looked to is a policy of the renter's own that stands issued over a declared trip which begins no
later than the collection moment of the rental and ends no earlier than its booked return.

| Messages the supplier has sent about the rental | The renter's own travel protection | Put back |
| --- | --- | --- |
| more than one | stands issued over such a declared trip | the whole of what is treated as withheld |
| one | stands issued over such a declared trip | 25 per cent of what is treated as withheld |

Where the supplier has sent more than one message about the rental and the renter's own travel protection
stands issued over a declared trip that begins no later than the collection moment and ends no earlier than
the booked return, the whole of what is treated as withheld is put back. Where the supplier has sent one
message about the rental and the renter's own travel protection stands issued over such a trip, 25 per cent
of what is treated as withheld is put back. Where neither holds of a rental, nothing is put back for the
supplier's messages.

## What each row requires

Both marks of a row must hold together. A rental carrying three supplier messages held by a renter with no
travel protection standing issued over such a trip reaches neither row.

The declared trip must span the rental at both ends. A trip beginning after the collection moment, or ending
before the booked return, is not a trip of the kind described, whatever its length.

A rental about which the supplier has sent no message reaches neither row.
